name: build-multi-target-tauri-apps
description: Build, debug, optimize and prepare Tauri 2 apps across desktop and mobile targets with grounded security, performance and platform evidence.

interface.longDescription: Eight focused skills cover architecture, frontend UX, native builds, IPC security, device QA, mobile speed, battery and memory efficiency, and distribution, with dated primary research and target-specific evidence.
defaultPrompt: Build and verify this Tauri app for desktop, iOS and Android.
Review Tauri IPC permissions and prepare release artifacts.
Optimize this Tauri app for mobile responsiveness, battery use and memory efficiency.
